masters.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite atlas for CrossNext's Aventura Lectora, matching the supplied existing monochrome monsters EXACTLY in visual weight: cute formidable fantasy game beasts, chunky black contours, flat white/light gray/dark gray, simple faces, no painterly textures, no color. Generate a NEW transparent landscape sprite sheet, exactly SIX equal columns and FOUR equal rows, 24 separate full-body sprites, generous transparent gutters, no cropping and NO text or grid lines. Each row contains TWO monsters, three poses for the first in columns 1-3, three for the second in columns 4-6. Poses in each trio: 1 standing alert ready to battle; 2 visibly weakened, bending legs, head lower, same anatomy; 3 defeated and resting flat on belly with closed eyes and folded limbs. Never rotate or mirror the ready pose to make defeated. Every trio is precisely the SAME creature with the same markings and silhouette; each of the EIGHT creatures is different. Row1: mushroom-crowned wild boar; thorn-antler stag. Row2: leaf-tailed lynx; armored badger with acorn shoulder plates. Row3: walking bramble bear; giant horned forest beetle. Row4: moss-shelled turtle; vine-winged griffin. Keep all subjects within their equal cells; blank gutters keep their horns and tails separate. Full body, all legs/tails/wings visible, facing left in three quarter view. Transparent alpha background, no ground shadows. Eight distinct designs, three genuine poses each.
